definitions.explanation: Food cooked by steam. A healthy cooking method that preserves nutrients and natural flavors.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{蒸|む}し{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦ヘルシー→ヘルシー：noentry⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Steamed dishes are healthy because they don't use oil.
Steamed fish brings out the natural flavor of the ingredient.

examples.english: Steamed dishes are said to be good for your health because they don't use oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蒸籠|せいろ}→蒸籠：28848_seiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{蒸|む}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ると→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{余分|よぶん}→余分：03667_yobun⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you use a bamboo steamer to make steamed dishes, it absorbs excess moisture and gives a better finish.

notes:
{蒸|む}し{物|もの} refers to steamed foods (⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧ = to steam).

Common Japanese steamed dishes:
- ⟦{茶碗蒸|ちゃわんむ}し→茶碗蒸し：17312_chawanmushi⟧ (savory egg custard)
- ⟦{肉|にく}まん→肉まん：28810_nikuman⟧ (steamed meat bun)
- ⟦{蒸|む}しパン→蒸しパン：28811_mushipan⟧ (steamed bread)
- ⟦{酒蒸|さかむ}し→酒蒸し：noentry⟧ (sake-steamed, e.g., clams)

Advantages of steaming:
- Preserves nutrients
- No added oil/fat
- Retains moisture and tenderness
- Brings out natural flavors

Equipment:
- ⟦{蒸籠|せいろ}→蒸籠：28848_seiro⟧ (bamboo steamer)
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{器|き}→蒸し器：08536_mushiki⟧ (steamer)

- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧ (grilled)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧ (fried)
